Convert a barcode chunk into a plate data frame

build_plate_matrix.Rd

Turns a character vector into a plate-shaped data frame with optional row and column labels and an optional decoration function that can alter the plate content (for control wells, etc.).

Usage

build_plate_matrix(
  chunk,
  nrow,
  ncol,
  row_labels = LETTERS[seq_len(nrow)],
  col_labels = seq_len(ncol),
  byrow = TRUE,
  decorate = NULL,
  plate_index = 1
)

Arguments

chunk

Character vector representing the barcodes for a single plate.

nrow

Number of rows of the plate.

ncol

Number of columns of the plate.

row_labels

Optional row names.

col_labels

Optional column names.

byrow

Logical; fill the matrix by row when `TRUE`.

decorate

Optional function called with `(plate_df, plate_index)` to modify the plate after creation.

plate_index

Index of the plate (passed to `decorate`).

Value

Data frame shaped like the plate.
